notes: 'shall have two' is added: the clause is verbless with no possessive preposition and no suffix, so rule 43 finds nothing to carry the 'have', and the numeral is not written in Hebrew.
תִּתְנַחֲלוּ keeps its head on the finite verb 'divide' with the inheritance complement in the same unit; the rule 44 reading heading on 'inheritance' is named on that unit.
